title: Planeward app manifest
description: planeward.json: how `planeward dev` runs and emulates a Planeward community app.

name.description: Display name shown in the emulator host.

slug.description: Lowercase slug; the local app id is `<slug>-local`.

experiencePath.description: Path on dev.url rendered in the Experience view.

dashboardPath.description: Path on dev.url rendered in the Dashboard view (admins).

webhookPath.description: Path on dev.url that receives signed webhooks.

scopes.description: Scopes the emulator grants the app.

command.description: Shell command that starts the app, e.g. `next dev --port 3005`.

url.description: Origin the app serves on, e.g. `http://localhost:3005`.
